bootstrap.unit: task, paired; GPT task-first mean over three banks

controls.H: existing frozen top_set: ratio then valid-degree tiebreak, corresponding prior arm H
controls.R: maximum accepted wins / accepted distinct opponents; zero degree ratio 1/2; exact rational ties

decision: Promote primary only if DS C-primary regret gain >=.01, GPT task-first pooled gain positive, primary gains vs each R and H positive for DS and pooled GPT; require C-primary 95% CI lower >0 and all leave-one gains positive in DS and pooled GPT for stability; else retain C0. Secondary descriptive only.
evidence: only unique trace entries with winner present and valid finite confidence >=.7 and <=1; no raw text, low confidence, unqueried edges or duplicate evidence; verify source trace uniqueness
limitations: All tasks are previously inspected development data
independence and fixed error odds are modelling assumptions, not calibrated probabilities
adaptive C0 scheduling and confidence masks remain fixed
offline final selection only; online generation and downstream behavior untested
metrics: normalized regret C0 minus new, task macro
best-hit probability under uniform selected ties
unique and accepted reads, cache ledger
CPU overhead per episode including median/p95/max

model.algorithm: Exact forward/backward subset dynamic programming O(n^2 2^n), arbitrary precision integer, n<=10
model.likelihood: independent fixed p=2/3 per accepted winner; order weight 2**number_consistent
model.primary: lowest posterior expected rank, equivalent highest expected rank percentile (n-rank)/(n-1)
model.prior: Uniform over all n! complete best-to-worst orders
model.ties: exact integer numerator equality; return all maximizers, evaluate uniform choice

question: Can one fixed posterior rank aggregator improve final selection on the identical accepted actual C0 trace?
scope: 850 identical jobs x DS1 (bank DS) plus three archived GPT banks, all 26 previously inspected development tasks; original selected C sets frozen; existing offline data only.
sealing: All 3400 new selection rows, controls and exact posterior summaries saved and SHA256 sealed before loading score labels or prior score receipts.
stage: before posterior implementation, selection and scoring
stopping: One fixed model and one complete four-bank pass. No sweep, training, new API calls, new data or online execution.
validation: exact permutations small graphs including no edges, reversed edges and symmetric cycle ties
all 3400 C and H selections/metrics match prior sealed receipts
exact 3400 C0 traces/selected/stats match independent existing trajectory run
new files confined to experiment directory
